description: How each action category selects and filters its targets; the actions table references a category by its id.

columns.name: display_name
columns.description: Informational plain-text label; not a key or gameplay value.

columns.name: selection
columns.description: Whether the player or AI picks the target. Automatic categories resolve without a target list: an environment action, or the area around the user.

columns.name: extent
columns.description: A single target, or every target inside the action's area: around a chosen ground point (chosen) or around the user (automatic).

columns.name: includes_user
columns.description: Whether the acting actor may appear in the target list.

columns.name: aim
columns.description: Whether each target is a whole actor or one of its limbs. Limb categories list every limb of each actor.

columns.name: target_kinds
columns.description: Actor kinds the category may target; 'none' targets no actor. Chest also adds the room's treasure chests to the target list.
